_about: What verify/from-json.js cannot fill mechanically for nerf-when, written by hand and read by it on every run (from-json.js --write gives the same data.js again). gists: a stratagem's one-line summary (the app's own words: its EFFECT shortened, its WHEN/TARGET condition kept, nothing added); def: its When targeted line; both AI-written (Claude, 24 Oct 2026) with the fingerprint (gistOf, defOf) of the text they were written from, so a changed source text fails the gate's fingerprints step. mod: a stratagem's weapon footnote (hand). rules: a detachment rule's Damage-tab calcMods (hand). units: per unit entry, its abilities' When targeted lines (def, AI-written, with defOf), its weapon footnotes (mods), notes on its abilities (notes: Supreme Commander's, as Ghazghkull Thraka's), its auras (only what GW tags (Aura), Core Rules 22.01) and stats values a rule of the list gives that New Recruit's export does not show. Each is a judgement verify/helpers.js lists for sign-off.

assault-brethren/armour-of-contempt.gist: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, an enemy unit targets your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit: attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

assault-brethren/gene-wrought-might.gist: Your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight: its melee attacks have [LANCE]; or, if the assault doctrine is active for it, [LANCE] and +1 AP.

assault-brethren/duty-in-death.gist: Fight phase, an enemy unit targets your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit: when a model of it is destroyed before your unit has been selected to fight, roll one D6 (+1 if the assault doctrine is active for it); on a 4+ that model is removed only when your unit has fought or at the end of the phase.

deathwatch-support/kraken-rounds.gist: Your KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have +6" range and +1 S.

deathwatch-support/dragonfire-rounds.gist: Your KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot: its ranged attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 and have [IGNORES COVER].

deathwatch-support/hellfire-rounds.gist: Your KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot: its ranged attacks (not [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks) have [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].

deathwatch-support/blackstar-extraction.gist: End of your opponent’s Fight phase: place your unengaged KILL TEAM unit in strategic reserves.

terminator-storm-force/tactical-dreadnou.gist: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, an enemy unit targets your ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit: attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

terminator-storm-force/merciless-veteran.gist: Your ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit is selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

terminator-storm-force/gunship-extractio.gist: End of your opponent’s Fight phase: place your unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit in strategic reserves.

roboute-guilliman.why: Codex Adept: the devastator doctrine is active for this unit (its ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]). Primarch of the XIII (Aura): friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6", his own unit included (22.01).

notes.Supreme Commander: Wahapedia core rules, 25.04 Fill Your Army Roster: “Some units have a rule on their datasheet stating that they must be your WARLORD. If you want to include one or more of these units in your army, you must select one of them to be your WARLORD.”

impulsor.why: Shield Dome: "This unit has 5+ InSv." BSData’s modifier gives it (the "+" mark names Shield Dome); New Recruit’s export shows none.
